description: Transcript-first redesign of the cut/keep decisioning, staged for the ralph loop (stories are passes:false so the loop picks them up in priority order). Re-centers the pipeline on the cut/keep decisioning gap: transcript-first editorial decisions driven by an explicit, editable base cut/keep prompt, with an option to auto-generate the criteria from a prior run's transcript, and a human-in-the-loop review gate before render. Vision/VLM is demoted to an optional secondary signal. Reuses the existing ralph/opencode loop, deepseek/kimi/local model routing, and ffmpeg/MoviePy render.

userStories.title: Audio Extraction + Local Transcription (timestamped transcript)
userStories.description: As the editor, I need a timestamped transcript of the footage so cut/keep decisions can be made from what is actually said, not from screenshot pixels.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract the audio track from the source video with ffmpeg (reuse audio.py extract_audio).
Transcribe locally on Apple Silicon (mlx-whisper preferred; faster-whisper / whisper.cpp acceptable) with word-level and segment-level timestamps.
Write transcript.json: array of {id, start, end, text, words:[{w,start,end}], confidence}.
Runs fully offline; model auto-resolved like the existing MLX models.
Typecheck and lint pass; unit test on a short fixture clip.
userStories.notes: DRAFT — FOR CONSIDERATION. This is the new 'text extraction' the redesign depends on. No transcription exists in the current repo (grep confirms zero whisper/speech/transcript code).

userStories.title: Transcript Segmentation into Utterance Units
userStories.description: As the editor, I need the transcript split into clean utterance segments so keep/cut operates on whole thoughts, never mid-sentence.
acceptanceCriteria: Segment the transcript on sentence boundaries and silence/pause gaps (configurable pause threshold).
Each segment carries a stable id, start, end, text, and duration.
Detect and tag long silences / dead-air gaps between segments.
Write segments.json; segments preserve chronological order.
Typecheck, lint, unit tests pass.

userStories.title: Base Cut/Keep Criteria Prompt (editable default)
userStories.description: As a creator, I want a concrete default editorial spec telling the tool what to cut vs keep, stored as an editable, version-controlled file.
acceptanceCriteria: Ship criteria/default.md: a base cut/keep prompt with explicit CUT rules (filler, dead air, false starts, retakes, tangents, interruptions, redundancy) and KEEP rules (substantive explanations, best take of a repeated line, hooks, CTAs, punchlines, demos, concise transitions).
Prompt defines a strict JSON output contract: per-segment {id, decision, reason, confidence, tag}.
Expose runtime tunables: aggressiveness (light|medium|heavy), filler_sensitivity (low|medium|high), always_keep[], always_cut[].
Criteria file is loaded by the classifier (US-103) and is human-editable without code changes.
userStories.notes: DRAFT — FOR CONSIDERATION. Replaces the dead DEFAULT_LLM_PROMPT in generate.py, which is prototyping-oriented ('tool use vs idle') and is never invoked because main.py hardcodes use_llm=False.

userStories.title: LLM Segment Classifier (the decisioning core)
userStories.description: As the editor, I want an LLM to read the timestamped segments under the criteria prompt and label each segment keep or cut with a reason and confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Feed segments.json + the active criteria prompt to the LLM; chunk long transcripts to fit context and stitch results by segment id.
Output cut_list.json: {decisions:[{id, decision, reason, confidence, tag}], keep:[{start,end}], stats}.
Validate every input segment id appears exactly once in decisions; default unmatched to keep.
Robust JSON parsing (strip code fences / prose) with a safe fallback that keeps everything and flags low confidence.
Route to deepseek/kimi/local via existing config; retries with backoff.
Typecheck, lint, unit tests (mocked LLM) pass.
userStories.notes: COMPLETED — Implemented in src/autovideo/classify.py. Includes criteria prompt injection, supplementary context support, transcript chunking (6000-char default), defensive JSON parsing (strips markdown fences, finds first/last brace boundaries), retry with exponential backoff (3 retries, 2x backoff), per-segment ID validation (deduplicates, rejects hallucinated IDs, defaults missing to keep), and rollback fallback when model unavailable. Tests in tests/test_classify.py. main.py and resume.py wired for transcript-first pipeline (transcribe → segment → classify → assemble → validate). mypy + ruff clean.

userStories.title: Retake / False-Start Deduplication
userStories.description: As a creator, when I deliver the same line several times I want only the best take kept.
acceptanceCriteria: Detect near-duplicate adjacent segments (normalized text similarity) as retake clusters.
Keep one take per cluster (prefer the last clean, most complete take; cut the rest) with rationale recorded.
Detect false starts ('let me start over', abrupt self-corrections) and cut the aborted attempt.
Decisions feed back into cut_list.json; unit tests on synthetic retake transcripts pass.
userStories.notes: COMPLETED — Implemented in src/autovideo/dedup.py as a deterministic pre-pass between segmentation and classification. Uses difflib.SequenceMatcher (threshold 0.75) on normalized text to detect adjacent near-duplicate retake clusters. Selects best take via heuristics (duration + sentence-boundary bonus). Detects false starts with regex patterns (e.g., 'let me start over', 'scratch that'). Flags inferior retakes and false starts in segments.json metadata (retake_cluster_id, is_best_take, false_start, dedup_reason). classify.py enforces these as hard overrides after LLM validation so the editorial decision is deterministic and recorded in cut_list.json. 10 unit tests in tests/test_dedup.py. Pipeline updated: transcribe → segment → dedup → classify → assemble → validate. mypy + ruff clean.

userStories.title: Human-in-the-Loop Review Gate (approve before render)
userStories.description: As a creator, I want to review and edit the proposed cut list before anything is rendered.
acceptanceCriteria: Emit a human-readable review.md (and/or editable cut_list.json): each segment with timestamp, text, decision, reason, confidence, and running 'time saved'.
Support a standard EDL/CSV export so cuts can be inspected or imported into a real editor.
Render (US-106) consumes only an APPROVED cut list; without approval it stops at review.
User decision overrides are captured and persisted (for US-108).
Typecheck, lint, tests pass.
userStories.notes: COMPLETED — Human-in-the-loop review gate implemented in src/autovideo/review.py. Generates review.md + cut_list_review.csv artifacts, supports CSV override editing, checks for cut_list.approved.json to unblock. Wired into main.py as Stage 4 between classify and assembly. --no-approval flag bypasses the gate. mypy + ruff clean, 10 new tests.

Emit criteria/<channel>.md in the same shape as the base prompt: concrete always_keep/always_cut lists, real filler words, recommended aggressiveness, and 2-4 few-shot examples drawn from the prior transcript.
